name: AMC Frecency Launcher
description: A launcher that learns: it counts which destinations this user opens and how recently, and at the next page load lifts the top three into ranked Your most used tiles with a heat meter and the last time they were opened, while the rest keep the developer's order in a compact grid.
useFor: Home pages and workspace launchpads with 6 to 20 destinations, where different users live in different corners of the app: finance opens Invoices and Month-end close, sales opens Orders and Customers.
helpText: Launcher list template that adapts to each user. Every time the user opens an entry, the time is stored in this browser's localStorage under amc-tpl-frecency-launcher:<application id>:<list id> (time stamps per entry, at most 30 per entry, entries unused for 120 days are forgotten; nothing is sent to the server). At page load each entry gets a frecency score, the sum of 0.5 to the power of age divided by a half-life of 10 days over its opens, and entries opened at least twice are ranked: the top 3 move into a numbered Your most used list, the rest stay in the developer's order as a compact grid. The order only changes at page load, never under the pointer. List items are moved in the DOM, so Tab order and screen-reader order always match the screen; the new favourites are announced politely once when they change. A first-time user sees the developer's order as full tiles with a hint. Reset order clears what was learned for this list. Attribute 1 is a description, Attribute 2 a badge such as 14 overdue, Attribute 3 an optional learning key: set it when the entry link carries values that change, otherwise the link without session, checksum and clear-cache values is the key. Template options: Adapt quickly uses a half-life of 3 days, Four favourites ranks 4, Filled favourites paints the ranked tiles in the primary color, Discreet hides the heat meter and last-opened time for shared screens, Rows shows everything else as a divided list. Without JavaScript, or when storage is blocked, it is a plain grid of launch tiles. Hover changes only the tile border. Reduced motion removes the meter fill and the arrival glow. English UI strings to translate in the template: the two hint sentences, Reset order, Your most used, Everything else, and the data-announce, data-reset-done and data-opened attributes on the wrapper; relative times come from Intl.RelativeTimeFormat in the page language.

templateOptions.name: Adapt quickly
templateOptions.help: Uses a half-life of 3 days instead of 10, so the favourites follow this week's work, for example during a month-end close.

templateOptions.name: Four favourites
templateOptions.help: Ranks the top 4 instead of 3, shown in one row in regions wider than about 700 pixels.

templateOptions.name: Filled favourites
templateOptions.help: Paints the ranked tiles with a primary-colored gradient so the personal part of the page stands out.

templateOptions.name: Discreet
templateOptions.help: Hides the heat meter and the last-opened time, for shared screens and kiosks; the ranking still applies.

templateOptions.name: Rows
templateOptions.help: Shows the entries that are not ranked as a divided list instead of a grid, for side columns.
